scope: Host-native task plan is current-session-only and optional
projection_scope: current phase plus remaining non-skipped phases through close

phase_mapping.route: Inspect context and choose the delivery route
phase_mapping.prototype: Produce runnable evidence for an open question
phase_mapping.spec: Lock scope, approach, acceptance, verification, dependencies, and risks
phase_mapping.tickets: Split durable work into explicit frontier tickets
phase_mapping.goal: Compile the selected frontier into a verifiable goal
phase_mapping.execute: Implement the approved contract and capture evidence
phase_mapping.review: Review against the recorded fixed point and resolve findings
phase_mapping.close: Verify the terminal condition and report final state

rules: Use a host-native plan or goal only when the active host supports an equivalent session feature.
Projection includes the remaining route, not only the current and next phase.
Plan Tree and Delivery Control remain authoritative when a host plan is unavailable, stale, or omitted.
Record plan_sync unavailable with an explicit handoff when the host lacks an equivalent feature.
Host-plan completion is not delivery evidence and never satisfies a close gate.
